name: Bouncy Castle JENT Entropy Provider
description: The BC RNG JENT package is a wrapper for JENT 3.6, certified for ARM and Intel. This jar contains binaries for the JENT package and a driver wrapper for which allows the jar to be configured as JCA provider, BCRNG, providing a single SecureRandom ENTROPY which returns JENT entropy from it's generateSeed() method. CMVP Entropy Certificate #E266. Please see certificate for full certified platform details.
